inbox.subject: 47 of our people have not been paid
inbox.body:
Good afternoon,

I have 47 people in my office who were not paid on Friday, and I have no answer for them. Our July file went to you the same way it goes every month. Nobody here changed anything.

Lenka tells me your system rejected them. I need to know why it rejected our people and not everyone else's, when we will be paying them, and whether this happens again in August.

I would also like to understand what compensation we are entitled to. We have store managers dealing with very upset staff at the end of the month.

Please call me today.

Markéta Sedláčková
Finance Director, Alpine Retail a.s.

inbox.subject: July run - rejected rows (PR-202607-0008)
inbox.body:
Hello,

I submitted the 2026-07 payroll yesterday morning as usual and the run came back partially completed. 47 rows rejected, the rest went through.

I have looked at the rejection report and I do not understand it. It says the bank account is not valid, but these are people who have been paid every month for years. I have not touched their records.

Report attached. Can somebody look before Friday's payment date?

Thanks,
Lenka Marešová
Payroll Manager, Alpine Retail

inbox.subject: Alpine - they are asking about the contract
inbox.body:
Markéta called me straight after she mailed you. She is asking for a service credit and she used the word terminate, which she has not done before.

Before I go back to her I need to know where we actually stand. Was this us or was it their data? And are they owed anything under the SLA, or am I offering goodwill?

They are 1,240 employees on Professional, Brno. Renewal is not close, but I do not want this sitting there.

Tomáš

inbox.subject: Re: CAS-40318 - what I have so far
inbox.body:
I have been through the run.

Every rejected row carries the same error code, and the run before this one was clean. Same customer, same channel, nothing different on their side that I can see.

I do not want to go back to Markéta with a guess. Can somebody check what went out recently and whether anything else has come in like this?

Ondřej

inbox.subject: Re: employee master - what format do you need?
inbox.body:
Markéta asked me to sort this out from our side.

I can pull the affected people out of our HR system and re-upload them, but I need to know exactly what you want in the bank account column and whether I upload only those people or the whole master again.

Also - our SFTP job runs at 06:00. If we re-upload today does it get picked up with the August run or do you need to reprocess July separately?

Jakub Horák
IT Manager, Alpine Retail

sent.subject: Re: Alpine - they are asking about the contract
sent.body:
Give me until tomorrow morning before you call her back. I do not want to say anything about credits until I know whether we were actually down, which I do not think we were.

Their run failed on validation. That is not the same thing, and the two get confused every time.
